idea:
# Summary
Replace the current backend-level timeout configuration with per-agent-role timeouts. Each agent role (implementer, qa, reviewer, etc.) should have its own configurable timeout value with a default of 2 hours.

# Requirements
- Remove backend-specific timeout configuration
- Add timeout configuration at the agent-role level (implementer, qa, reviewer, etc.)
- Set default timeout to 2 hours (7200 seconds) for all agent roles
- Ensure timeouts are enforced during agent execution
- Maintain backward compatibility or provide clear migration path if backend timeouts currently exist in configs

# Constraints
- Default timeout: 2 hours for all agent roles
- Configuration should be per-role, not per-backend
- Should work across all backend types (API, local, etc.)

# Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Backend timeout configuration removed from codebase
- [ ] Agent-role timeout configuration added (implementer, qa, reviewer, etc.)
- [ ] Default 2-hour timeout applied to all agent roles
- [ ] Timeouts properly enforced during agent execution
- [ ] Configuration file schema updated to reflect new timeout structure
- [ ] Existing timeout logic refactored to use role-based timeouts
- [ ] Tests updated to verify role-based timeout behavior
